generated_from: metamodel/official-mappings.json plus the gap-fill assessment in docs/mapping-logic-planning.md §5
note: One entry per official-mapping ID. Existing official mappings keep their source reference; every entry gets a rule decision, the step that fills its instances (0 BIAN architecture dataset, 1 data join, 2 rule application, 3 derivation, 4 structural matching, 5 text inference), the data that step needs, the reasoning, and a confidence (high/medium/low) that the connection is a sound mapping and that the chosen fill produces correct instances. Attribute keys named in data_needed are defined in metamodel/export-conventions.json (added after the E1 run showed the joins had no keys).

steps.0: BIAN architecture dataset — A2 architecture dataset extracted from the public portal under the institution's licence
steps.1: data join — the institution's own records (CMDB, deployment manifests, API gateway, data catalogue)
steps.2: rule application — BIAN's published REST mapping (action term, qualifier, control-record resource, HTTP method)
steps.3: derivation — closure over approved arrows already in the federated graph
steps.4: structural matching — attribute names/types, API paths, sequence structure; explainable score
steps.5: text inference — description similarity, model-assisted ranking; last resort

rule_decisions.historical_method: rests on W135 (2013); not a rule unless re-validated
rule_decisions.derived_path: a query over other arrows, never a stored record
rule_decisions.institution_only: no external authority; an institution may adopt it as enterprise_rule
rule_decisions.subsumed: an instance of an existing registry rule via the entity hierarchy; no separate rule
